definitions.gloss: entry into the water; the moment of entering the water
definitions.explanation: In diving and swimming, the act or moment of entering the water. In diving, a clean, near-splashless entry is a mark of good technique. Read にゅうすい; also used with する.

examples.japanese: きれいに{入|にゅう}{水|すい}する。
{飛|と}び{込|こ}みは{入|にゅう}{水|すい}の{美|うつく}しさが{採点|さいてん}される。
examples.english: In diving, the beauty of the entry into the water is scored.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}しぶきを{抑|おさ}えた{入|にゅう}{水|すい}が{高得点|こうとくてん}につながった。
examples.english: An entry that kept the splash down led to a high score.

notes:
A swimming and diving term for entering the water. Read にゅうすい here; the same characters read じゅすい refer to drowning oneself, an unrelated word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入|にゅう}{水|すい}する: to enter the water
- きれいな{入|にゅう}{水|すい}: a clean entry
- {入|にゅう}{水|すい}{角度|かくど}: angle of entry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}み: diving — the sport/act of jumping in; {入|にゅう}{水|すい} is specifically the entry moment
